title: Managing Our Waste
summary: Biodegradable and non-biodegradable waste, the 3 Rs, composting, and how our choices affect the environment.
objectives: I can classify waste as biodegradable or non-biodegradable.
I can evaluate ways to manage waste.
misconceptions: Biodegradable waste is harmless in any amount.
Recycling is always better than reducing.
Burning plastic gets rid of it safely.
